items.summary: § 572.1 Scope. This part describes the anthropomorphic test devices that are to be used for compliance testing of motor vehicles and motor vehicle equipment with motor vehicle safety standards. [60 FR 43058, Aug. 18, 1995]

items.title: § 572.2 Purpose.
items.summary: § 572.2 Purpose. The design and performance criteria specified in this part are intended to describe measuring tools with sufficient precision to give repetitive and correlative results under similar test conditions and to reflect adequately the protective performance of a vehicle or item of motor vehicle equipment with respect to human occupants.
